title: Lispico declaration catalog
description: Version-2 inert declaration catalog for Go-defined Lispico symbols. Catalogs are non-executable data: they describe host and library symbols with verified facts only. Unknown signature or type information must remain absent — never replace it with invented varargs. Actual Lisp source remains the authority for its own definitions.

owner.description: Owning project or module, for example "go-lispico", "zhk", or "yagel".

source_version.description: Exact release version the entries were verified against. Exactly one of source_version and source_revision is required.

source_revision.description: Exact source revision the entries were verified against. Exactly one of source_version and source_revision is required.

source_fingerprint.description: Prefixed SHA-256 content fingerprint of the verified source snapshot, so dirty development trees are not labeled as an unchanged release. Required whenever source_files is present.

source_files.description: Verified source files as canonical relative POSIX path strings. Present only together with source_fingerprint.

dialect.description: Dialect the declarations apply to. Vocabulary aliases and CL adapter signatures differ between dialects.

profiles.description: Host profiles the declarations apply to. Dynamic workflow helpers must only appear in catalogs usable by yagel-workflow contexts.

library.description: Library ID this catalog describes, for example "core", "stdlib", "json", "zhk", or "yagel".

allOf.description: Lisp-1 (clojure) dialects resolve every symbol through the value cell only.
The path manifest is meaningful only when paired with the aggregate snapshot fingerprint.

relative_path.description: Canonical relative path: `/` separators, no leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, and no empty, `.`, or `..` segments. Segments starting with a dot are allowed when longer than two characters or followed by more input.

name.description: Exact symbol name as exposed by the runtime, including any namespace prefix such as "zhk/read".

kind.description: Symbol kind. Non-callable host bindings must use "value" and must not fabricate a signature.

cell.description: Namespace cell the symbol lives in. Lisp-1 (clojure) dialects resolve through the value cell only; Lisp-2 (cl) dialects honor both cells.

result.description: Verified result or value information, when known.

arity.description: Verified argument information. Absent when unknown; never guessed.

max.description: Maximum accepted argument count; null means a verified rest parameter with no fixed upper bound. Must not be smaller than min (JSON Schema draft-07 cannot compare sibling numbers; enforce out of band).

rest.description: Whether a `&` rest argument is accepted.

phase.description: Verified execution-phase availability, for example "staging", "live", or "callback". Absent when no phase boundary is proven.

source.description: Where the verified fact came from. Without a host source path, editors fall back to this catalog location; they must not fabricate one.

path.description: Source file path relative to the owning repository root.

then.description: Value entries carry no signature, so arity must stay absent.
